name: Hoshizaki Mei
source: A grade school-aged girl, who skipped several grades, so now she's in high school with [url=http://vndb.org/c13945]Akira[/url] though she's even younger than [url=http://vndb.org/c13950]Kurumi[/url]. She is very shy and cannot make friends easily, not to mention her only friend is Akira. She often wonders what the girls her age are like and if she should have stayed in elementary school. Her alternate reality version is a super genius magical girl and good friends with [url=http://vndb.org/c13947]Miruku[/url]. Because she's young, she's the least effected by sexual desire when using her magic. She also loves cats.
